title: My first Steam game - Crystal Wars, demo out now!
author: Prujinkin
selftext:
# Crystal Wars

Take turns and play on a new, unique crystal map each time. The core mechanic is flood-fill capture: you pick a color and claim all adjacent cells of that color, expanding your territory. On top of that there are additional mechanics like energy crystals, bombs, supply cutting and obstacles. 

Tutorial, campaign, quick games, custom regime and different presets designed for you by me.   
  
**Demo on Steam**: [https://store.steampowered.com/app/4810920/Crystal\_Wars/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/4810920/Crystal_Wars/)  
**Web demo**: [https://play.crystalwars.io/](https://play.crystalwars.io/)

Matches run up to 5 minutes. There's also local multiplayer available and online play.

I wanted every match in my game to feel naturally exciting, so I had AI agents play tens of thousands of matches on different procedural maps.

I created a specific parameter called the **"Drama Index"** to measure how fun a board is.   
It tracks initiative swings, territory losses, supply line cuts, and neck-and-neck gameplay.   
By crunching the data from these automated matches, I managed to tweak the generation formula and find the exact game settings that guarantee a highly dynamic and satisfying session for the player)

It was a massive time-saver compared to manual playtesting!

Involvement: I've been working on this with Claude and my daughter helped out with QA testing. I really hope you like it! :)
